info.title: Equipment Booking API
info.description: Shared lab equipment. Availability is expressed in half-open UTC intervals [from,to). Error bodies use stable machine-readable codes.

get.description: Free intervals after subtracting confirmed reservations and scheduled maintenance.

post.description: Employees only. Times are normalized to UTC. Successful retries for the same employee and key return the original receipt, even after cancellation. Conflicts return SLOT_CONFLICT or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scheduled maintenance also occupies the equipment.

put.description: Lab administrator only. First checkout requires server time in [from,to). Replaying checkout returns its original receipt, including after return.
Lab administrator only. An active loan can be returned after its due time. Replaying return yields the first receipt. The original booking interval remains reserved.

get.description: An employee may see only their own progress. A lab administrator may look up any reservation by ID.
Lab administrator only. Events in transaction order. Historical reservations expose known facts and events recorded after upgrade.
Administrator only. Lists new status events in version order, including events awaiting fan-out and all replay operators.

post.description: Administrator only. Opens a new attempt round for an exhausted delivery, retaining its message ID and history.

get.description: Reservation owner or administrator. Existing and unassigned reservations return null.

put.description: Administrator only, on a confirmed reservation before checkout.

503.description: Required database schema or subscriptions unavailable

post.description: Administrator only. Schedule a half-open window. Conflicts with confirmed reservations and scheduled maintenance.

get.description: Administrator only. Lists scheduled and cancelled windows overlapping the range, ordered by start time.

delete.description: Administrator only. Repeated cancellation retains the original actor and time.

coverage.description: from_migration means pre-upgrade changes have no recorded event.

post.description: Delivered to the preconfigured endpoint for this organization. Verify the Standard Webhooks signature and timestamp on the original body. eventId equals webhook-id. Confirmed has version 1, cancelled version 2.

204.description: Accepted, including duplicates and older versions
